#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
out=/tmp/flash-sass-issue53-gates.4F55qE/model-attempt-2
printf '%s\n' "$$" >"$out.supervisor.pid"
date -u +%FT%TZ >"$out.supervisor-started.txt"
HC_GPU=7 HC_WAIT_SECONDS=2700 GPU_LOCKDIR=/home/nate/codex/asm-port \
 timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 7800s \
 bash /tmp/flash-sass-issue53-gates.4F55qE/model_check.sh \
 /tmp/flash-sass-issue53-resume.IwwJba/baseline \
 /tmp/flash-sass-issue53-resume.IwwJba/candidate \
 /mnt/sentry-nfs/flash-next-q2/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00001-of-00002.gguf \
 /mnt/sentry-nfs/flash-next-q2/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2_0-00002-of-00002.gguf \
 /home/nate/codex/flash-pr35-cache-20261017/tensors "$out"
result=$?
printf '%s\n' "$result" >"$out.supervisor-exit.txt"
date -u +%FT%TZ >"$out.supervisor-finished.txt"
exit "$result"
